name: Counting Hair
overview: Scripture reveals God's intimate knowledge and care for His people by affirming that even the very hairs of our heads are numbered, demonstrating His detailed attention to our lives. This truth, emphasized in Matthew 10:30 and Luke 12:7, assures believers of their immense value to God, who watches over them with tender concern. Furthermore, Luke 21:18 promises divine protection, affirming that not a single hair on a believer's head will perish, underscoring God's sovereign preservation amidst trials.
